- Backbone: PaliGemma (SigLIP So400m/14 + Gemma 2B) + Action Expert (Gemma 300M)
- Total: ~3.3B params, **18 transformer layers** (NOT 32)

- Full first-class support in OpenPI
- Evaluation: `examples/libero/main.py` via WebSocket policy server
- π₀.₅ LIBERO checkpoint: 96.85% avg success
- LIBERO-Plus perturbed eval: drop-in replacement for LIBERO lib

- PyTorch: NOT official, but Issue #842 has working implementation (26.5M params, 96.95% on LIBERO)
